# EMS Medical Director Legal Issues and Liability

**Authors:** Aaron R. Kuzel, Evan A. Kuhl

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

In September 2010, Emergency Medical Services (EMS) became the sixth official subspecialty of Emergency Medicine. Unlike many other supervisory roles in medicine, the role of the EMS medical director is unique. As the specialty has grown, the part of the EMS medical director has become more high-profile. Not only has the importance of EMS medical directors become more recognizable amongst other medical specialties, but legal professionals have brought further scrutiny to the role. EMS medical directors must be familiar with this field's many legal and liability issues.
